name: Certificate
oneLiner: a rolled certificate of heavy cream paper drops onto a black leather blotter and unrolls down the frame on twos, its engraved border printed in the brand colour, a name in script, then a wax seal in the brand colour is pressed on with the brand mark in it
say: when the speaker names an achievement or a finished milestone ('you have officially completed it', 'that is the proof'): the certificate unrolls as they say it and the seal presses on the payoff word
